newsitem.title: UK: Toad makes cash-call to raise 7.1 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Toad makes cash-call to raise 7.1 mln stg.

text.p: Toad Plc said on Friday it plans to raise 7.1 million stg through a placing and open offer of 9.6 million new ordinary shares at 80p per share.
The offer will be on the basis of five new ordinary shares for every nine ordinary shares held. Toad said dealings in the new shares are expected to commence on January 10, 1997.

The vehicle technology group said the funds raised will be essential to support its current level of investment and will also make it possible to "exploit the significant opportunities which are now emerging in target markets."
It also said application has been made for the admission of the ordinary Shares and the new ordinary shares to the Official List of the London Stock Exchange from AIM.
The company also revealed that it made a loss before tax for the six months to September 30, of 2.46 million stg compared with a loss of 801,000 previously.
